script_text: Stop, Taurus—your money chart just got a live wire. Sun and Moon are conjunct at 24° Gemini in your 2nd House, while Venus, your ruling planet, at 4° Leo in your 4th House trines Mars at 2° Aries in your 12th House. That trine pours fire into Taurus earth: desire, pride, and impulse move fast. Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd House trines Mars, so one message unlocks action. Taken: don't argue about routines; single, creative magnetic attention comes through an errand or financial chat. With the New Moon in your 2nd House, send the invoice, name your rate, or pitch the idea now. Pluto in your 10th House supports a career move if the number stays clean. Avoid a rushed home purchase or dramatic loans; the gift is a referral through a sibling or neighbor. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
